review_notes: Issue #3268 reports long retry loops after cancellation during multithreaded S3 uploads, and merged PR #3552 fixes the issue by letting concurrent.futures.CancelledError escape URLLib3Session.send.
The material production change is confined to botocore/httpsession.py::URLLib3Session.send; tests/unit/test_http_session.py and the removed temporary botocore_main.py are excluded from ground truth.
Issue #472 reproduces escape() failure for str subclasses, and merged PR #477 fixes it by relaxing PyUnicode_CheckExact to PyUnicode_Check in the C speedups implementation.
Retain only src/markupsafe/_speedups.c as production ground truth; CHANGES.rst, pyproject.toml, and tests/test_escape.py are excluded, and C symbol ground truth remains empty.
Issue #29256 reports that WebAgg ignored figure.canvas.manager.set_window_title, and merged PR #29338 fixes the behavior in FigureCanvasWebAggCore.handle_refresh by using manager.get_window_title().
Retain only lib/matplotlib/backends/backend_webagg_core.py::FigureCanvasWebAggCore.handle_refresh; the API-change document is excluded, and the PR demonstration is not a repository ground-truth file.
Issue #4810 reproduces ccompiler TypeError for valid pyproject.toml define-macros lists, and merged PR #5169 converts each TOML macro value to the tuple shape expected by _ext_modules.
The production fix is confined to setuptools/config/_apply_pyprojecttoml.py::_ext_modules; the regression test and news fragment are excluded.
Merged PR #10011 directly fixes Issue #9645 by passing GenericIPAddressField protocol through get_field_kwargs and removing duplicate IP validators.

The production scope is rest_framework/utils/field_mapping.py::get_field_kwargs; tests/test_model_serializer.py is excluded, while the PR follow-up stack is retained as an attribution risk rather than separate ground truth.
Merged PR #34399 closes Issue #31030 by sorting the sparse neighborhood graph after DBSCAN.fit sets its diagonal, preventing the unconditional EfficiencyWarning.

The production fix is confined to sklearn/cluster/_dbscan.py::DBSCAN.fit; the regression test and whats-new entry are excluded, and related Issues #34218 and #31337 are recorded as attribution overlap rather than separate cases.
Merged PR #115 closes Issue #7 and implements one behavior chain for LF and mixed header delimiters across the receive buffer, readers, and connection state machine.
All three h11 production files are retained; tests and the news fragment are excluded, and the Issue's sparse reproduction remains an advisory diagnostic-risk note.
Merged PR #1713 directly closes Issue #1689 and applies shared invalid-code validation to configuration parsing and plugin classification.

All three production files are retained while tests are excluded; defaults.py adds only a module-level regular expression, so symbol ground truth is recorded for parse_config and _classify_plugins only.
Merged PR #646 directly closes Issue #431: HookCaller._remove_plugin removes every implementation and PluginManager.get_hookcallers deduplicates the resulting callers.
Both production files and pre-fix symbols are retained; the changelog and plugin-manager regression tests are excluded.
Merged PR #122 directly closes Issue #121 and detects an incomplete binary or TLS ClientHello request as invalid instead of leaving the server waiting forever.
The reader and receive-buffer production files are both required; tests and the news fragment are excluded, and ReceiveBuffer is the pre-fix owner of the newly introduced helper.

rejections.reason: PR #1638 is a documentation-only follow-up whose body states that behavior is unchanged; Issue #1458 was already closed by PR #1645, while yarl/_query.py contains only a docstring change and CHANGES/1638.doc.rst is changelog metadata.

Issue #31 is a discussion-driven outgoing-header casing feature rather than a concrete defect report, and its automatic four-file scope includes a formatting-only readers change; the batch retains the two stronger h11 defect cases instead.
